threat_event: Ransomware on business IT disrupts nominations, measurement, and invoicing and forces a precautionary shutdown of a pipeline system because OT integrity cannot be confirmed quickly
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large IT attack surface (16,000 endpoints, about 620 applications); energy is a frequent target; shutdown criteria not exercised at GCC-2 or PS3-CR (R-012)
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-08 to SYS-11; BP-05, BP-06, BP-10; PS-1 deliveries (P05)
regulatory_driver: C-ENERGY-R03 (SD 02G III.D.4; III.F.1.d); C-ENERGY-R02 (SD 01G II.C); SEC Form 8-K Item 1.05
existing_controls: 24x7 SOC; EDR on 98% of IT endpoints; immutable backups; DMZ isolation exercised at GCC-1; operate-or-shut-down decision tree (P08)
treatment_plan: Exercise isolation at GCC-2 and PS3-CR (POAM-012); add curtailment factors to the materiality playbook and run a disclosure committee tabletop (POAM-013); annual enterprise ransomware exercise with gas control
key_risk_indicator: IT/OT isolation time in exercises; EDR coverage; days since last isolation test per control room

threat_event: A software fault or compromise of the common SCADA platform affects GCC-1 and GCC-2 at the same time
threat_source: Nation-state actor; or a defective vendor release
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One SCADA platform and version at both control centers; contingency plan covers loss of a site, not of the platform
existing_controls: Staged releases through the SCADA test environment; offline backups; manual operation plan
treatment_plan: Add a platform-wide failure scenario to the contingency plan; offline golden images of the prior release; run a drill (POAM-011)
key_risk_indicator: Contingency plan scenarios tested; time to restore a SCADA host from offline image

threat_event: A nation-state actor pre-positions in OT using living-off-the-land techniques to enable disruption during a crisis
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No passive monitoring at 22 compressor stations and at meter and valve sites; living-off-the-land activity is hard to detect
existing_controls: OT monitoring cell; passive monitoring at both GCCs and 74 stations; threat hunting each quarter
treatment_plan: Extend monitoring to the remaining 22 stations (POAM-005); hunt for living-off-the-land indicators from CISA advisories each quarter
key_risk_indicator: Stations with OT monitoring; hunts completed

threat_event: An attacker issues unauthorized commands through a compromised legacy station HMI
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 22 stations with end-of-support HMIs or PLC firmware with Known Exploited Vulnerabilities entries
existing_controls: Station firewalls; documented mitigations at 15 of 22 stations; hardwired emergency shutdown systems
treatment_plan: Complete mitigations at the other 7 stations; replace HMIs and PLC firmware in the 2027 to 2028 program (POAM-003)

threat_event: An attacker enters PS-3 OT through flat station networks or the legacy SCADA and disrupts PS-3 operations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 12 of 20 PS-3 stations on flat networks; local accounts; no OT monitoring; unencrypted polling over shared MPLS; no hot standby
existing_controls: PS-3 DMZ built 2025; EDR on PS-3 Windows hosts; amended Cybersecurity Implementation Plan schedule
treatment_plan: Segment the 12 stations; encrypt polling; migrate PS-3 to the main SCADA and GCC-1 (POAM-016)
key_risk_indicator: PS-3 stations segmented; PS-3 points migrated

threat_event: An attacker exploits a Known Exploited Vulnerabilities entry on an unpatched OT host
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9% of applicable Known Exploited Vulnerabilities items past timeline; 31 stations not credential-scanned
existing_controls: Patch strategy with risk categories; Known Exploited Vulnerabilities prioritization; mitigations where patching is not possible
treatment_plan: Clear the overdue items or document mitigations with dates (POAM-002); extend credentialed scanning (POAM-020)
key_risk_indicator: Overdue Known Exploited Vulnerabilities items on Critical Cyber Systems

threat_event: A former employee who knew a shared station HMI password uses it to change station settings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared operator accounts at 31 stations; 4 of 25 sampled departures did not trigger a password change
existing_controls: Station physical access; shared account register
treatment_plan: Automated shared-password change ticket on departure; quarterly reconciliation (POAM-001)

threat_event: An attacker uses an always-on vendor cellular modem to reach a compressor station network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 7 manufacturer modems outside the OT remote access gateway (11 of 18 removed)
existing_controls: Modems restricted to turbine monitoring VLAN; carrier private network
treatment_plan: Remove the 7 modems and move monitoring through the gateway (POAM-004)
key_risk_indicator: Remote access paths outside the gateway

threat_event: A stolen vendor credential is used for a malicious session through the OT remote access gateway
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 210 vendor users; vendor endpoint hygiene outside company control
existing_controls: MFA; per-session approval; session recording and live monitoring
treatment_plan: Require hardware tokens for vendor users; review session recordings each week

threat_event: Intrusion activity at a station without OT monitoring goes undetected for weeks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No passive monitoring at 22 stations; local logs only
existing_controls: Station firewalls; periodic log pulls during investigations
treatment_plan: OT monitoring sensors at the 22 stations (POAM-005)

threat_event: False field data is injected so controllers act on wrong pressures or flows
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Legacy protocols without message authentication; some cellular sites
existing_controls: Front-end range validation; IPsec on carrier links; controller cross-checks against adjacent points
treatment_plan: Authenticated protocols in new RTUs; anomaly rules for physically impossible values

threat_event: IT/OT isolation is slow or fails at GCC-2 or PS3-CR during an incident
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Isolation exercised only at GCC-1; PS-3 manual operation not drilled since the acquisition
existing_controls: Isolation procedure and authority defined (POL-03); exercised at GCC-1 on 2026-03-18
treatment_plan: Exercise isolation at GCC-2 and PS3-CR; drill PS-3 manual operation (POAM-012)
key_risk_indicator: Control rooms with an isolation exercise in the last 12 months

threat_event: A material incident is disclosed late or inaccurately because the materiality process does not cover an operational shutdown
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Disclosure committee has not exercised an OT shutdown scenario; playbook lacks reservation credit and shipper claim factors
existing_controls: Disclosure committee charter; 8-K templates; CISO briefs General Counsel within 24 hours
treatment_plan: Add curtailment factors to the playbook; tabletop with the disclosure committee on 2026-11-12 (POAM-013)

threat_event: A reportable cybersecurity incident is not reported to CISA within 72 hours
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Severity triage by many teams; definition includes events under investigation
existing_controls: Reporting clock in the case system; Cybersecurity Coordinator on call 24x7; 14 reports filed in 2025-2026, all on time
treatment_plan: Quarterly test of the reporting workflow

threat_event: TSA finds Cybersecurity Implementation Plan measures not implemented on schedule, or plan amendments filed late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PS-3 amended schedule depends on migration; 2 permanent changes in 2026 were not submitted as amendments within 50 days
existing_controls: Monthly CIP measure tracking; TSA liaison by the Cybersecurity Coordinator
treatment_plan: File the 2 amendment requests; add an amendment check to change management (POAM-022)

threat_event: SSI is disclosed to persons without a need to know
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 3 of 25 sampled TSA submission records unmarked
existing_controls: SSI training for covered persons; labels in the productivity suite
treatment_plan: Mandatory labels on the TSA submission library; quarterly marking check (POAM-010)
key_risk_indicator: Unmarked SSI records in quarterly sample

threat_event: CEII engineering data is exfiltrated from the integrity and analytics platform
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large engineering data sets in Cloud provider B; many engineering users
existing_controls: Named engineering groups; logged exports; encryption with customer keys
treatment_plan: Data loss prevention on bulk exports; quarterly access recertification

threat_event: Shipper commercial data is exposed through the shipper services platform
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Internet-facing platform with about 2,900 shipper users
existing_controls: MFA; tenant isolation tests; WAF; SOC 2 Type 2
treatment_plan: Add Confidentiality to the SOC 2 scope; annual tenant isolation penetration test

threat_event: Employee personal information is breached, triggering notices in several states
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 12,000 employees in 9 states; payroll and HR data in SaaS
regulatory_driver: State breach laws (Fla. Stat. 501.171 worked example)
existing_controls: Vendor SOC reports; MFA; multi-state notification workflow (P08)
treatment_plan: Review payroll vendor breach notice terms; annual tabletop of the multi-state workflow

threat_event: Business email compromise leads to a fraudulent payment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High-value vendor and JV payments; phishing volume
existing_controls: Callback verification for bank changes; payment dual approval; phishing training
treatment_plan: Payment anomaly detection in the ERP
key_risk_indicator: Bank change requests verified by callback

threat_event: A controller or engineer deliberately issues unsafe commands
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Authorized users can command assigned segments
existing_controls: Area-of-responsibility permissions; command logging; background checks; supervision; hardwired overpressure protection
treatment_plan: Behavior analytics on command patterns

threat_event: Deliberate damage to telecommunications sites cuts SCADA visibility in a region
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Remote microwave and radio sites
regulatory_driver: C-ENERGY-R02 (SD 01G II.C (physical attack on network infrastructure))
existing_controls: Path diversity on PS-1 and PS-2; site alarms; satellite backup
treatment_plan: Residual risk accepted by the CISO with the COO; path diversity covers most sites

threat_event: An intruder at an unstaffed compressor station tampers with station controls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 35 stations are unstaffed at night
existing_controls: Fences, badge readers, video, intrusion alarms monitored by security operations
treatment_plan: Cabinet intrusion switches in the replacement program (SR-9)

threat_event: Loss of the single PS-3 carrier or of cellular service blinds controllers to part of the network
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PS-3 has one MPLS carrier; 140 meter and valve sites are cellular-only
existing_controls: Flow computers store data; field reads
treatment_plan: Second carrier for PS-3; second path at the 40 most critical cellular sites (POAM-021)

threat_event: A hurricane disables GCC-1 and forces operation from GCC-2 for days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: GCC-1 in Florida
existing_controls: GCC-2 more than 200 miles away; staff relocation plan; annual failover test
treatment_plan: Pre-season relocation drill each June
key_risk_indicator: Days to full staffing at GCC-2 in drills

threat_event: A cloud region outage stops the shipper services platform
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single-provider dependency for SL-1
existing_controls: Warm standby region; tested 2026-06-09 (3.2 hours)
treatment_plan: Reduce failover time with automated database promotion

threat_event: A measurement data error goes undetected and shippers are misbilled
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual adjustments at month close
regulatory_driver: Contract (tariff billing); SOX IT general controls
existing_controls: Hash checks; dual approval of edits; shipper statement review
treatment_plan: Automated reconciliation of SCADA and measurement volumes (SL-1 Processing Integrity)

threat_event: A cloud storage misconfiguration exposes CEII
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many engineering data sets
existing_controls: Guardrails block public storage; daily posture scans
treatment_plan: Quarterly guardrail tests

threat_event: Ransomware actors delete or encrypt IT backups
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Backups are a common target
existing_controls: Immutable backups in separate accounts; offline copies at DC-2; quarterly restore tests
treatment_plan: Annual clean-room restore test of tier-1 IT systems

threat_event: Malicious code arrives in a trusted SCADA or station control software update
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor build environments outside company control
existing_controls: Staged testing in the SCADA test environment; hash verification; allowlisting at GCCs
treatment_plan: Vendor security attestation and signed updates; extended soak testing for major releases (POAM-014)

threat_event: A vulnerable third-party component in SCADA software goes unidentified because there is no software bill of materials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SCADA vendor provides no software bill of materials
existing_controls: Vendor advisories; passive vulnerability identification
treatment_plan: Require software bills of materials at contract renewal (POAM-014)
key_risk_indicator: Critical OT suppliers providing software bills of materials

threat_event: A SOX IT general control deficiency in ERP access is reported
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large ERP user base
existing_controls: Quarterly access reviews; SOX testing
treatment_plan: Automate role conflict checks

threat_event: Malware reaches an OT engineering workstation on a transient device or USB
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Transient devices used at stations
existing_controls: Scanning kiosks; USB disabled at GCCs; company-owned transient devices
treatment_plan: Kiosks at all regional offices; transient device inventory checks

threat_event: A transferred employee keeps OT access they no longer need
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Transfer reviews done manually
existing_controls: Transfer workflow; quarterly certification
treatment_plan: Automated transfer trigger to OT access review (POAM-008)

threat_event: Mitigations for components that cannot have passwords reset lapse past their timeline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 14 components with mitigations past due
existing_controls: Mitigation register
treatment_plan: Complete mitigations and add due-date alerts (POAM-007)

threat_event: Station logs roll over before an investigation needs them
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 22 stations keep 90 days locally
existing_controls: Local logs; manual pulls
treatment_plan: Forward logs from the 22 stations (POAM-006)

threat_event: A display or alarm change without point-to-point verification misleads a controller
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2 of 40 sampled changes lacked verification records
existing_controls: Management of change; test environment
treatment_plan: Workflow blocks release without a verification record (POAM-009)

threat_event: An alarm flood during a cyber event overwhelms controllers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Alarm rationalization done for PS-1 and PS-2 only
existing_controls: Alarm management plan; simulator training
treatment_plan: Cyber AOC simulator module for PS-3 controllers; PS-3 alarm rationalization at migration (POAM-017)

threat_event: The leak-detection model misses a small leak on cellular-only or PS-3 segments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Lower data quality on cellular sites; model not validated on PS-3
existing_controls: Advisory use only; SCADA alarms primary; patrols continue
treatment_plan: Validate on PS-3 before use there; coverage indicator; telemetry upgrades (P10)

threat_event: The leak-detection model vendor deploys an unvalidated model update
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor has deployment rights in the workload
existing_controls: Staging slot exists but was bypassed twice in 2026
treatment_plan: Remove vendor production rights; contract amendment (POAM-019)

threat_event: Staff paste SSI or CEII into an unapproved generative AI tool
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Public generative AI tools are easy to reach
existing_controls: Approved enterprise AI assistant; training
treatment_plan: Unapproved generative AI domains blocked at the web proxy since 2026-04

threat_event: False alerts from the leak model distract controllers from SCADA alarms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 2.1 false alerts per shift on PS-1 in July and August 2026
existing_controls: Separate screen; alert volume in the controller workload review
treatment_plan: Retune thresholds (P10)

threat_event: AI use cases run without committee review
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 4 of 11 use cases unreviewed
existing_controls: Intake block in procurement since 2026-03
treatment_plan: Complete the 4 reviews (POAM-023)

threat_event: The predictive maintenance model wrongly defers compressor maintenance
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model suggests intervals
existing_controls: Engineers approve every interval change; OEM limits enforced
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Director of Compression Engineering with GRC concurrence

threat_event: A DDoS attack slows the shipper services platform at a nomination deadline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Internet-facing platform
existing_controls: Provider DDoS protection; WAF; tariff allows extended nomination windows during outages
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Vice President, Commercial Operations with GRC concurrence

threat_event: Credential stuffing compromises shipper user accounts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 2,900 shipper users
existing_controls: MFA for all shipper users; bot protection
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA option for shipper administrators

threat_event: The single toll-free emergency line provider fails and calls do not reach gas control
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One toll-free provider
existing_controls: Direct GCC numbers held by 9-1-1 centers; answering service
treatment_plan: Second toll-free provider with automatic failover
owner: Vice President, Pipeline Safety and Compliance

threat_event: A zero-day in an internet-facing edge device (VPN or firewall) is exploited
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Edge devices are a frequent initial access path
existing_controls: Emergency patch service level of 72 hours; zero-trust access replacing VPN
treatment_plan: Retire the remaining VPN concentrators by 2027-03-31
key_risk_indicator: Internet-facing devices with Known Exploited Vulnerabilities

threat_event: Compromise of the enterprise identity platform gives broad access to IT and cloud
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single identity platform for IT; no trust to OT
existing_controls: Phishing-resistant MFA for administrators; identity threat detection
treatment_plan: Tier-0 administration workstations
owner: Director of Identity and Access Management

threat_event: An unauthorized change to DMZ firewall rules opens a path into OT
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Quarterly rule reviews
existing_controls: Change control; rule review; alerting on rule changes
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Director of OT Security with GRC concurrence; controls strong

threat_event: Loss of key OT security and SCADA engineering staff slows remediation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Small specialist teams; PS-3 knowledge held by few people
existing_controls: Retention incentives; cross-training
treatment_plan: Document PS-3 legacy knowledge before migration

threat_event: A colocation data center outage interrupts IT services
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two sites with failover
existing_controls: Second site; provider SOC 2 reports
treatment_plan: Accepted by the CIO with GRC concurrence

threat_event: A JV owner receives another owner's confidential data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Owner portal permissions set manually
existing_controls: Per-owner access tests
treatment_plan: Automated permission tests on each release

threat_event: A contractor acting as an authorized representative does not follow plan measures
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 140 suppliers with OT access or data
existing_controls: Contract terms since 2024; onboarding briefings
treatment_plan: Annual attestation from authorized representatives

threat_event: An outage of the posting site causes a tariff posting violation
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Postings depend on SYS-09
existing_controls: Email blast fallback for critical notices
treatment_plan: Static fallback posting page in Cloud provider B

threat_event: PHMSA cites 192.631 record gaps (alarm reviews, point-to-point records)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PS-3 alarm records on a separate system; 2 missing verification records
existing_controls: Compliance tracker; annual internal review
treatment_plan: Single records repository for all three control rooms
owner: Vice President, Pipeline Safety and Compliance

threat_event: An electric utility outage stops an electric-driven compressor station
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 12 electric-driven stations
existing_controls: Flow rerouting through gas-driven stations
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Vice President, Field Operations with GRC concurrence

threat_event: An attacker uses default credentials on a PS-3 field device
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Default passwords found on 5 PS-3 RTUs during P07 testing
existing_controls: PS-3 field devices reachable only from the PS-3 SCADA network
treatment_plan: Change defaults on all PS-3 devices; add to migration checklist (POAM-018)

threat_event: PS-3 SCADA traffic on shared MPLS is intercepted or altered
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PS-3 polling crosses corporate MPLS unencrypted
existing_controls: Carrier private network; VLAN separation
treatment_plan: IPsec tunnels for PS-3 polling (POAM-016)

threat_event: Incident response at PS-3 is slowed by separate tools and procedures
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: PS-3 not yet in the SIEM for OT events; separate runbooks
existing_controls: Enterprise incident plan applies; PS-3 contacts in the binder
treatment_plan: Onboard PS-3 OT logs and include PS-3 in exercises (POAM-012; POAM-016)

threat_event: A future acquisition closes without security due diligence or funded integration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Growth strategy includes acquisitions
existing_controls: POL-01 4.10 requires due diligence and a 12-month integration plan
treatment_plan: Add a TSA plan amendment step to the deal checklist
key_risk_indicator: Deals with completed security due diligence

threat_event: The Item 106 description of processes is inaccurate
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Statements not tested by Internal Audit
existing_controls: Disclosure committee review
treatment_plan: Internal Audit tests each statement before the next 10-K

threat_event: Cyber insurance does not cover an OT-driven shutdown
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Exclusions for war and infrastructure events vary
existing_controls: Broker review at renewal
treatment_plan: Accepted by the CFO; the shutdown scenario is mainly self-insured

threat_event: Unmanaged PS-3 devices are missed because the OT inventory is incomplete
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 7 of 60 sampled PS-3 devices not in inventory
existing_controls: Monthly reconciliation for PS-1 and PS-2
treatment_plan: Field walkdowns at PS-3 stations; passive discovery with new sensors (POAM-015)

threat_event: A ransom is paid to a sanctioned party
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Pressure to restore during a shutdown
existing_controls: POL-03 requires an OFAC check, counsel, and CEO approval before any payment
treatment_plan: No payment without the POL-03 conditions; checks are mandatory
